method.label: Craft
method.meaning: A way of doing the work of the field, with a procedure and a thing it produces.
method.how: Name the thing you produced and what changed because of it.

practice.label: Working with people
practice.meaning: Getting work done through other people and structures: partners, stakeholders, teams, programmes.
practice.how: Say who you worked with, how many, and what you were trusted with.

behaviour.label: How you work
behaviour.meaning: A way of working that every field asks for and no one lists. Shown through how the other work was done.
behaviour.how: Never a line of its own: let a line about real work show it.

technical.label: Technical
technical.meaning: Fluency with systems, data and software as a subject, not a tool.
technical.how: Say what you built, queried, shipped or decided on technical grounds.

knowledge.label: Domain
knowledge.meaning: An industry, a market or a body of rules the work sits in.
knowledge.how: Name the industry, product or rule set in the lines of work that touched it.

tool.label: Tools
tool.how: Name the tool inside the line of work that used it, not only in a skills list.

credential.label: Credentials
credential.meaning: Degrees, licences, certifications, years and backgrounds.
credential.how: Name it once, with its date, where a reader looks for it.

forms.through: Shown through lines about other work; never its own line.
forms.scope: Who you worked with or led, how many, what size, what you were trusted with.
forms.artefact: The thing you produced, and what changed because of it.
forms.outcome: A number you owned and moved.
forms.built: What you built, queried or shipped.
forms.context: The industry, product or rule set the work sat in.
